text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her training, Special Week, looking flustered, approaches me about something.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The others in my class have been getting better and better lately.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I can't lose to them! So I wanna train a little more today!
choice_data_list: Got it! Then let's do some more laps until you're satisfied!
Don't get too excited, or you might overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'm gonna do my best to produce some good results!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We continue our training until the very last minute.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-you were right… I think I got a little too worked up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I need to cool myself down. Deep breaths… Phew… Fwaaah

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week appears to have calmed down, but I still have to do something about her overzealousness…
